Prepare ADSL / ADTTE records for a TTE table

Source: R/prep_ttni.R
prep_ttni_data.Rd

Accepts either a single ADSL-like data frame that already contains TTE variables (PARAMCD, AVAL, CNSR, EVNTDESC) or a separate ADTTE data frame joined to ADSL by subject. An empty result after filtering is returned as a structured list (empty = TRUE) rather than an error so the teal module can show a no-data message.

Usage

prep_ttni_data(
  adsl,
  adtte = NULL,
  arm_var = "TRT01A",
  ref_arm = NULL,
  paramcd = "TTNI",
  subject_var = "USUBJID",
  paramcd_var = "PARAMCD",
  aval_var = "AVAL",
  cnsr_var = "CNSR",
  evntdesc_var = "EVNTDESC",
  population_var = "SAFFL",
  population_value = "Y"
)

Arguments

adsl

ADSL or combined subject-level TTE data.

adtte

Optional ADTTE data frame. If NULL, adsl is used as the TTE source.

arm_var

Treatment / grouping variable.

ref_arm

Optional reference arm for two-arm comparisons.

paramcd

Analysis parameter code.

subject_var

Subject identifier.

paramcd_var

PARAMCD variable name.

aval_var

Analysis value variable.

cnsr_var

Censor variable (0 = event).

evntdesc_var

Event / censor description variable.

population_var

Optional population flag variable.

population_value

Population flag value to keep.

Value

A list with analysis data, design metadata, description levels, and empty (TRUE when no records remain).
